definitions.explanation: An honorific term used to refer to someone else's son, showing respect toward the person being addressed and their family. Never used for one's own son.

examples.japanese: ご{子息|しそく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
ご{子息|しそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧そうです⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: I hear your son passed the university entrance exam.

examples.japanese: ご{子息|しそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、さぞお⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことでしょう。
examples.english: Your son has grown into a fine person — you must be very proud.

notes:
Composed of the honorific prefix ご and ⟦{子息|しそく}→子息：28912_shisoku⟧ (son). This is a formal, respectful way to refer to another person's son, typically used in business settings, formal letters, and polite conversation with social superiors. For one's own son, use the humble term {愚息|ぐそく} or simply ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{子息|しそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧: your son's employment
- ご{子息|しそく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧: your son's marriage
- ご{子息|しそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧: please give my regards to your son

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧さん: your son — polite but less formal than ご{子息|しそく}
- ⟦{御令息|ごれいそく}→御令息：29766_goreisoku⟧: your son — even more formal and literary
- {愚息|ぐそく}: my (foolish) son — humble term for one's own son

REGISTER:
Used in formal and business contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧さん is more natural.
